# Datagent plugins

Datagent brings Southeast Asian company data into AI assistants: company profiles, financials, ownership, directors and executives, listings and corporate events for Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand, plus workspace watchlists and private notes.

MCP server (Streamable HTTP): `https://mcp.datagent.io/mcp` — OAuth on Business and Enterprise plans, or an Enterprise API key with the `mcp` scope. Connect it from https://app.datagent.io/ai-connections.

## Install

### Claude Code

```bash
/plugin marketplace add datagentio/datagent-plugins
/plugin install datagent@datagent
```

### Antigravity

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/datagentio/datagent-plugins
```

### Gemini CLI

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/datagentio/datagent-plugins
```

### Codex skills

```text
$skill-installer install the skills from https://github.com/datagentio/datagent-plugins/tree/main/skills
```

### ChatGPT

Connect `https://mcp.datagent.io/mcp` as a custom connector.
